title: A Tutorial on World Models and Physical AI
title_zh: World Models 与 Physical AI 教程
abstract_en: World modeling is emerging as a central principle for building intelligent systems capable of prediction, reasoning, and decision making. A central distinction can be drawn between explicit world models, which learn structured dynamics for rollout-based reasoning and planning, and implicit world models, which encode predictive structure within scalable learned representations. These complementary paradigms provide a foundation for physical AI in domains such as robotics and autonomous driving, enabling intelligence beyond reactive control under real-world constraints. Recent foundation models further suggest a pathway toward unified systems integrating perception, prediction, and action. Despite rapid progress, major challenges remain in hierarchical reasoning, long-horizon planning, and autonomous goal formation, which are critical for advancing toward artificial general intelligence. This tutorial presents a coherent framework in which diverse world modeling approaches are unified through shared predictive structure and differentiated by how such structure is represented and exploited.
abstract_zh: 世界建模（World Modeling）正成为构建具备预测、推理与决策能力的智能系统的核心原则。论文区分了两类范式：显式世界模型（explicit world models）学习结构化动力学，用于基于 rollout 的推理与规划；隐式世界模型（implicit world models）则将预测性结构编码进可扩展的学习表征中。二者互补，为机器人、自动驾驶等 Physical AI 场景提供基础，使智能系统能够在真实约束下超越反应式控制。近期 foundation models 进一步展示了将感知、预测与行动整合为统一系统的可能路径。然而，层级推理、长时域规划与自主目标形成仍是迈向 AGI 的关键挑战。本文以教程形式提出统一框架，将多样化 world modeling 方法归结为共享的预测结构，并根据其表示与利用方式进行区分。
key_points_zh: 提出一个统一视角：不同 world modeling 方法都依赖预测结构，只是在结构的表示方式与使用方式上不同。
区分显式世界模型与隐式世界模型：前者适合结构化动力学、rollout 推理和规划，后者适合大规模表征学习与可扩展预测。
强调 world models 对 Physical AI 的基础作用，尤其是在 robotics、autonomous driving 等需要真实世界约束下决策的任务中。
讨论 foundation models 可能推动感知、预测、推理与行动的一体化，为更通用的智能系统提供路径。
指出关键开放问题包括层级推理、长时域规划和自主目标形成，这些能力被视为通向 AGI 的重要瓶颈。

llm_assessment.comment: As a tutorial on world models and physical AI, it is broadly informative but not a contribution to agent harness infrastructure.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 作为世界模型和物理AI教程，它有综述价值，但不是智能体框架基础设施贡献。
